_comment: Derived from Bodycam/Content/GM/Gamemode/*.uasset (GM_Menu excluded, it's not a playable mode). team_based controls whether the UI shows a Team Cap field. Default caps for 'working' modes are the shipped DataAsset defaults, seen in reference.md / confirmed live. 'status' is one of: working (confirmed hostable and plays correctly); untested (class exists, never attempted); no_content (class/asset reference exists -- LoadAsset+StaticFindObject resolves it -- but hosting into it demonstrably does not engage it as the active gamemode, i.e. it's a leftover/stub reference with no real playable content behind it, NOT a bug in working content); broken (it DOES engage as the active gamemode but something is actually wrong during play). See 'note' on any non-working entry for why, and knowledge_base/CAPABILITIES.md for the full live-testing history. Every status is still listed (not hidden) so nothing about the game's own content is hidden from the Host tab -- the Gamemode picker groups by this field and shows the note for whichever one is selected.

Zombie.note: Class confirmed to exist (2026-09-07, via LoadAsset+StaticFindObject). Its real maps are 'Assylum'/'Village' (DT_UI_ZombieMaps) but their live package paths aren't confirmed -- see maps.json's own unconfirmed entries for the guesses tried. Never successfully observed live as the active gamemode; cap/team defaults here are guesses, not measured.

Pit.note: Class confirmed to exist (2026-09-07). Its real maps are 'Pit'/'Logistics' (DT_UI_PitMaps), paths unconfirmed. Never travel-tested at all yet. cap/team defaults are guesses.

OnlyPistol.note: Class confirmed to exist (2026-09-07). Travel attempts on the known-good AirSoft map did not engage the class (stayed on GM_Bodycam_C) -- but a same-session sanity check with the already-proven Deathmatch ALSO failed the same way, so this looks like a broader session-state issue from repeated test travels that day, not proof OnlyPistol itself is broken. Needs a clean retest in a fresh game session before trusting either way.

Training.note: Confirmed live 2026-09-07: hosting this on 'Shooting Range' changes the level (get_current_level_name() correctly shows ShootingRange) but the gamemode never actually switches (get_live_state() still reports GM_Bodycam_C) -- i.e. the class exists but isn't wired up as a real hostable mode, not a bug in working content. Practical result of trying anyway: falling endlessly with no way out but quitting. Likely a practice-range backdrop not meant to be entered via servertravel. Do not use from the Host tab.
